title: WOW Actions File
description: A standalone YAML list of action items. Included into task files via '<yamllist>: path' inside an 'actions:' list, or nested within another actions file. Enables composability: large action trees can be split into focused, reusable files.

Task.description: A single WOW task. At run time, WOW resolves the pool, builds variables, and executes the action tree.

task.description: Human-readable task name. Injected as variable 'task_name'. Optional — defaults to empty string.

description.description: Task description. Can be multi-line. Injected as variable 'task_description'.

out.description: Base output path for task artifacts (relative to the tasks directory). Resulting path: ${out}/${prefix}/${tag}[/${subdir}]. Requires --prefix/-p at runtime.

subdir.description: Sub-directory appended to the output path. Defaults to the 1-based task index when multiple tasks are in the file; omitted for single-task files.

endpoint.description: Default endpoint name for all actions in this task. Must be defined in 'pool:' or be the built-in 'localhost'. Default: 'localhost'.

via.description: Default access protocol for all actions. One of: 'native', 'ssh', 'http', 'serial', 'namespace'. Default: 'native'.

nolock.description: Disable endpoint locking for this task. Default: false.

variables.description: Task-level variables available throughout all actions. Substituted via ${name}. Can be overridden by action-level variables or CLI: -V name value.

pool.description: Endpoint pool. Each entry is a named group of endpoints sharing a connection spec. Groups with the same name are merged.

actions.description: Top-level action list for this task.

<yamldict>.description: WAML merge directive. The mapping in this YAML file is merged into the task object at load time. Use to split task-level configuration (pool:, variables:, endpoint:, etc.) across files.

Variables.description: Key-value variable map. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, lists, or dicts. String values support ${var} substitution. Type-suffix keys generate indexed access: name.csv, name.list, name.map.

PoolEntry.description: One equipment group in the pool. Duplicate group names across pool entries are merged (spec and ignores must match).

group.description: Group name. Referenced as 'endpoint:' value in actions.

ignores.description: Endpoint names to exclude from this group entirely.

variables.description: Group-level variables substituted into endpoint definitions at pool-build time.

Spec.description: Endpoint validation rules and flat-promotion control.

required.description: Map of required endpoint field names to a validation constraint: a regex string or an explicit list of allowed values. 'name' is always required implicitly.

oneOf.description: Regex pattern the field value must fully match.

excludes.description: Fields excluded from flat variable promotion. Still accessible via dot-path: ${EndpointName.field}. 'viae' is always excluded regardless of this list.

major-key.description: The required field used as secondary grouping key. Defaults to the first required field other than 'name'.

Endpoint.description: An endpoint (device or host). All fields become endpoint variables accessible as ${field} (flat-promoted) or ${EndpointName.field} (dot-path).

name.description: Unique endpoint name within its group. Must satisfy the 'name' regex in spec.

viae.description: Connection back-ends keyed by via name ('ssh', 'http', 'serial', 'native', 'namespace'). Always excluded from flat promotion.

nolock.description: Disable connection locking for this transport. Default: false.

ActionItem.description: One entry in an actions list. Can be: a bare shell-command string; a structured action/auto/direct-feed node dict; or a WAML include directive.

anyOf.description: Shorthand: executed as a shell command on the active via.

WamlDirective.description: WAML include directive. Processed at load time before any action runs. '<yamllist>:' splices a YAML list file into the current list; '<yamldict>:' merges a YAML mapping file into the current mapping.

<yamllist>.description: Path to a YAML file whose top-level list is spliced in place of this directive.

<yamldict>.description: Path to a YAML file whose top-level mapping is merged into the parent node.

variables.description: Variables substituted into the included file before it is spliced.

enabled.description: If false, the included content is entirely omitted.

ActionNode.description: A structured action node. Must have exactly one payload key: 'actions', 'commands', 'files', 'http-actions', 'snippets' (list payloads) or a direct-feed key ('text', 'command', etc.). Auto nodes use 'auto:' in place of a payload key and require 'template:'.

action.description: Display label shown as a section header in output. Set to null to suppress the header. Injected as variable 'action_name'.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this node. Boolean or Python expression string.

stoppable.description: Mark this action as a soft-stop exit point (first SIGINT). The action itself completes; subsequent siblings are skipped and the stop propagates up.

.on-stop.description: Handler action that runs when soft-stop is triggered while this action is executing. Runs at most once per invocation. Streams it writes are visible to parent pipes via 'sources:'.

parallel.description: Run child actions concurrently in separate threads. Boolean or Python expression.

vertical.description: Split tmux panes side-by-side (true) instead of stacked (false) when 'parallel: true'. Default: false.

percent.description: Tmux pane size as a percentage of parent pane when 'parallel: true'. Values across siblings are relative.

endpoint.description: Endpoint name for this action. Overrides the value inherited from parent. Must be defined in the task pool or be 'localhost'.

via.description: Access protocol. String: named via. List: first available wins. Dict: anonymous inline via — {ViaType: {params}} — requires no named endpoint.

oneOf.description: Try each via in order; use first available.

quite.description: Suppress all output from this action and its children.

verbose.description: Emit extra diagnostics: via name, status codes, pipe/filter flow.

check.description: Propagate child exit-status failures to this action's status. Boolean or Python expression.

indent.description: Indent child output under this action's header. Default: true.

stop-on-fail.description: Stop remaining sibling actions if this action fails.

stream.description: Override this action's default output stream name. Siblings can read it with +[stream-name].

http-params.description: Default HTTP parameters inherited by all http-actions in this subtree. Can also be used to make anonymous HTTP calls (endpoint is then ignored).

variables.description: Action-scoped variables available to this node and its children. Override task-level variables of the same name.

filters.description: Shorthand filter chain applied to this action's default output stream. Equivalent to a single pipe with no stream or sources override.

pipes.description: Named filter chains applied to one or more of this action's output streams.

commands.description: List of command items executed sequentially on the active via.

auto.description: Auto-node generator. Expands 'template:' once per row produced by the data source. String form: 'args', 'range', or 'data'. List form: multiple sources zipped together (all sources must yield the same row count or zip to the shortest).

oneOf.description: Multi-source auto node. Each item declares one source. They are zipped: iteration N uses row N from every source.
Template expression resolving to one of the valid type strings.

template.description: Template expanded for each auto-node row. A list of ActionItems (when inside 'actions:') or CommandItems (when inside 'commands:').

prefix.description: Prefix for auto-node loop counter exports: ${prefix.index}, ${prefix.count}. Does NOT prefix field variable names from data files.

index.description: Starting value for the loop index. Default: 1.

offset.description: Index offset added to range/data indices. Default: 0.

args.description: For 'auto: args'. List of argument definitions. Each item maps a variable name to a comma-separated value string. Special wrapper keys 'permutation:' and 'union:' group multiple variables.

x2args.description: For 'auto: args'. Second-expansion argument nodes. Substituted after the first 'args' expansion to produce derived variables.

eval.description: Direct-feed (command context): evaluate a Python expression and emit the result. String value is the expression.

delimiter.description: For 'auto: args'. Delimiter used when splitting argument value strings. Default: ','.

range.description: For 'auto: range'. Range spec: an integer N gives range(N); [stop], [start, stop] or [start, stop, step] mirrors Python's range(). Each value may be an integer or an expression string (which may contain ${var}/+{export} templates) evaluated to an integer, e.g. "${start}-1".

data.csv.description: For 'auto: data'. Path to a CSV data file (relative to the wow2 root).

data.yaml.description: For 'auto: data'. Path to a YAML data file (relative to the wow2 root).

range.ie.description: For 'auto: data'. Like 'range' but excludes empty rows before index selection ('ie' = ignore-empty).

filter.description: For 'auto: data'. Python expression evaluated per data row. {} is the row dict; {.index} is the 0-based row index; [:key:] is dict-key shorthand. Rows where the expression is falsy are excluded.

filter.var.description: For 'auto: data'. Variable name whose current value is used as the filter expression instead of an inline 'filter:' string.

filter.range.description: For 'auto: data'. Range applied to post-filter rows (e.g. '0:5' or '2,4,6').

filter.offset.description: For 'auto: data'. Index offset for 'filter.range'. Default: 0.

command.description: Direct-feed: a shell command string. Promotes this dict into a commands action.

text.description: Direct-feed: emits the value as a literal string stream.

etext.description: Direct-feed: emits repr() of the value.

int.description: Direct-feed: emits int(value[, base]). Append base as modifier: 'int.16' for hex.

json.description: Direct-feed: emits the value serialised as JSON. Append indent as modifier: 'json.2'.

import.description: Direct-feed: reads the named Exports key (+{name}) into the stream.

getstream.description: Direct-feed: reads the named stream (+[name]) into the stream.

export.description: Exports key under which to store the output. Also exposes '<key>.stderr' and '<key>.status'.

http-action.description: Direct-feed: a single HTTP request. Promotes this dict into an http-actions action.

file.description: Direct-feed: a single file operation. Promotes this dict into a files action.

snippet.description: Direct-feed: a Python snippet. Value is a path to a .py file or an inline snippet dict with 'code:'.

AutoSourceSpec.description: One source entry in a multi-source 'auto: [...]' list. Declares the data source type via its primary key and optional per-source modifiers. All sources are zipped by row index.

args.description: CSV/list argument source. Items map variable names to comma-separated values.

x2args.description: Second-expansion argument nodes for this args source.

eval.description: Derived-variable expressions computed from this source's row. Only meaningful on the first source entry.

delimiter.description: Delimiter for splitting arg value strings. Default: ','.

range.description: Numeric range source. Same spec as single-source 'range:' — integers or expression strings evaluated to integers.

data.yaml.description: Path to a YAML data file.

data.csv.description: Path to a CSV data file.

filter.description: Row filter expression for data sources.

filter.var.description: Variable name whose value is used as the filter expression.

range.ie.description: Range with ignore-empty semantics for data sources.

prefix.description: Prefix for this source's loop counter exports: ${prefix.index}, ${prefix.count}.

AutoArgsItem.description: One item in an 'args:' list. Either a direct variable assignment or a special grouping construct.

oneOf.description: Direct assignment: maps a variable name to a comma-separated value string or a YAML list.
Permutation grouping: produces the cartesian product of all variable values.

permutation.description: Maps each variable name to a comma-separated value string. All combinations (cartesian product) of the values are generated.

oneOf.description: Union grouping: concatenates multiple value lists for the same variable.

union.description: Maps each variable name to a comma-separated value string. The value lists are iterated in parallel (zipped); duplicate combinations are dropped.

Repeat.description: Repeat settings. Keys NOT starting with '.' are written to Exports on every iteration and accessible via +{key}. Control keys start with '.'.

.count.description: Maximum iteration count. Use 'inf' for indefinite. Default: inf.

.until.description: Stop-condition Python expression evaluated after each iteration. References Exports via +{name}. Stops when truthy.

.interval.description: Minimum seconds between cycle starts. How the next start is scheduled depends on '.strategy'.

.strategy.description: 'normal': next cycle starts immediately after the previous finishes (or after any remaining interval time). 'strict': next cycle starts after the remaining interval slot elapses even if the previous cycle overran. Default: 'normal'.

.check.description: Propagate each iteration's exit status to the parent action. Default: true.

.log.description: Accumulate output from all iterations (true) or keep only the last (false). Default: true.

.stoppable.description: Allow soft-stop (SIGINT) to break out of the repeat loop. Default: false.

.prefix.description: Prefix for loop-counter Exports: +{prefix.index}, +{prefix.count}. Prevents collisions in nested repeat loops.

.index.description: Starting value for the loop index export. Default: 1.

CommandItem.description: One entry in a 'commands:' list. A plain string is a shell command. A dict has one feed key plus optional modifiers. Auto nodes can also appear here (template items are then CommandItems).

CommandNode.description: A structured command-feed dict. Exactly one feed key must be present. The key may carry a dot-suffix modifier ('int.16', 'json.2'). Auto node keys ('auto:', 'template:') are also valid here.

command.description: Shell command executed on the active via.

text.description: Emit the value as a literal string.

etext.description: Emit repr() of the value (escaped string).

bool.description: Emit bool(value) as a Python bool.

int.description: Emit int(value[, base]). Append base as modifier: 'int.16' for hex.

json.description: Emit value as JSON. Append indent as modifier: 'json.2'.

eval.description: Direct-feed (command context): evaluate a Python expression and emit the result. String value is the expression.

import.description: Read an Exports key (+{name}) and emit its value.

getstream.description: Read a named stream (+[name]) and emit its value.

export.description: Exports key to store this command's output under. Also exposes '<key>.stderr' and '<key>.status'.

stoppable.description: Allow soft-stop during execution of this command. Default: false.

rw_retries.description: Read/write retry count before failing (SSH via).

stream.description: Output stream name for this command's result.

auto.description: Auto generator within a commands list. 'template:' items are CommandItems.

template.description: Template expanded per auto-node row. Items here are CommandItems.

FileItem.description: A file-transfer or file-system operation on the active via.

mode.description: File mode as an octal integer (chmod).

check.version.description: Command that reports the installed version (upgrade). Exit 0 means upgrade is needed.

on.up-to-date.description: Command to run when already up-to-date (upgrade).

on.success.description: Command to run after a successful upgrade.

on.fail.description: Command to run after a failed upgrade.

path.description: URL path relative to the via's base address.

always-login.description: Force a fresh login before every request. Default: false.

auth.description: Authentication parameters passed to the via.

args.description: Request parameters passed to via.request(). Append '.json' to a key to serialise its value as JSON before sending.

stream.description: Output stream name for this request's response.

SnippetItem.description: A Python snippet. The script must define a 'wowmain' function. Its return value is written to the output stream.

code.description: Inline Python code or path to a .py file.

args.description: Positional arguments passed to wowmain(). May include +[stream] expressions.

stream.description: Output stream name for this snippet's result.

FilterList.description: Ordered list of filter operations applied to the stream in sequence.

FilterItem.description: One filter step. A string names a filter method ('ClassName.method'). A dict is a filter call with arguments or an if/elif/else conditional block.

oneOf.description: Filter method: 'ClassName.method' (e.g. 'TextFilter.strip', 'JsonFilter.get_path') or a Python builtin (e.g. 'str'). Applied with no arguments.
Filter call with arguments, or a conditional block. For a call: key is 'ClassName.method', value is the argument(s). For a conditional: keys are 'if', 'elif', 'elif.N', 'else'.

FilterBranch.description: Conditional filter branch (if / elif). Executes its filter list when 'condition' is truthy.

condition.description: Python expression. {} is replaced with the current stream value. Truthy → branch executes.

FilterElseBranch.description: The else branch of a conditional filter — always executes if no preceding if/elif matched.

PipeList.description: List of pipe definitions that route and transform named streams.

AutoPipeNode.description: Auto generator inside a 'pipes:' list. Expands 'template' once per generated row (auto: range/args/data); ${.value}, ${.index}, ${.count} are substituted per row, producing dynamic pipe entries.

auto.description: Auto generator type. 'template:' items are PipeItems.

template.description: Pipe entry or entries expanded per generated row.

PipeItem.description: A single pipe. Reads from 'sources', applies 'filters', writes to 'stream'. Nested 'pipes' chain further transformations on the output stream.

stream.description: Output stream name. '*' = pass-through mode: sources are forwarded unchanged (filters and nested pipes not allowed in this mode).

PipeSources.description: Input stream selector for a pipe. String: one stream name or '*' for all. List: explicit stream names. Dict: dynamic selection by name pattern.

oneOf.description: Single stream name, or '*' to select all available streams.
Dynamic stream selection. Exactly one selector key must be present.

startswith.description: Select streams whose names start with this string.

endswith.description: Select streams whose names end with this string.

contains.description: Select streams whose names contain this string.

regex.description: Select streams matching this regex (re.search; prefix with ^ to anchor).

range.description: Generate stream names from 'template' for indices in this range.

template.description: Stream name template used with 'range'. Supports ${sources.value}, ${sources.index}, ${sources.count}.
